gold: Paracentral acute middle maculopathy in sickle cell disease

selector.rationale: Patient has sickle cell disease and presents with retinal findings consistent with sickle cell retinopathy, including black sunburst lesions and ischemic macular whitening.

rejected.label: Central Retinal Artery Occlusion
rejected.why: Normal cilioretinal, retinal arteriolar, and retinal venous filling on fluorescein angiography contradicts this diagnosis

rejected.label: Diabetic Retinopathy
rejected.why: No mention of diabetes in the vignette and presence of sickle cell disease makes this diagnosis less likely

rejected.label: Retinal Ischemia
rejected.why: While retinal ischemia is a possible finding, sickle cell retinopathy is a more specific diagnosis that explains the patient's symptoms and findings
